terms.name: Catalog identifier
terms.description: Class to identify that a parameter is a catalog identifier. The rationale for this type of parameter is that in some cases datasets may be downloaded in the software component itself, rather than exposed as an input

terms.name: Configuration Setup
terms.description: Special type of configuration in which some of the inputs or parameters are associated to files or values. A configuration may be associated to multiple setups to facilitate its execution.

terms.name: Constraint
terms.description: Data constraints of a configuration

terms.name: Data Transformation
terms.description: Class that represents a software for performing data transformation.

terms.name: Data Transformation Setup
terms.description: Special type of data transformation where the inputs and parameters have some pre-selected values. For example, they may point to a particular dataset URL to be used in the transformation

terms.name: Dataset Specification
terms.description: Class designed to describe a type of input or output used or produced by a model. For example, Topoflow has several inputs. One of them is a text file with precipitation values. The representation of this input is an instance of a dataset specification.

terms.name: Funding Information
terms.description: A class to represent the funding information of a software project

terms.name: Image
terms.description: An image (e.g. tiff file) is a type of dataset specification used to define certain inputs of models like soil, crops, etc.

terms.name: Numerical Index
terms.description: A number (such as a ratio) derived from a series of observations and used as an indicator or measure (https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/index)

terms.name: Organization
terms.description: An organized body of people with a particular purpose

terms.name: Parameter
terms.description: A parameter of the model.

terms.name: Person
terms.description: A human being (individual)

terms.name: Sample Collection
terms.description: A collection of resources that are used as sample for running a sfoware component multiple times

terms.name: Sample Execution
terms.description: A sample execution of a given software

terms.name: Sample Resource
terms.description: A sample resource associated with a software

terms.name: Software
terms.description: The set of instructions that indicate a machine how to work. In this ontology software is a general concept which acts as a superclass for software versions, docker images, data transformations, etc.

terms.name: Software Configuration
terms.description: A software configuration represents a particular way of invoking a function of a software component. A software configuration exposes the precise inputs and outputs that are used for that function. Multiple software configurations may be associated to a software component. A software configuration facilitates the encapsulation of software, and it can be used to represent components of scientific workflows.

terms.name: Software Image
terms.description: An image that virtualizes the functionality of a given software. For example, a Docker container.

terms.name: Software Version
terms.description: A software version is a specificf type of software that represents a particular set of functionalities. New functionalities and error fixes may occur between software versions

terms.name: Source Code
terms.description: Class representing the characteristics of the code associated with a  software component

terms.name: Standard Variable
terms.description: A standard variable, necessary to refer to all the variable using the same nomenclature in a domain ontology. For example, a standard variable may be a SVO variable (http://www.geoscienceontology.org/geo-upper#Variable)

terms.name: Unit
terms.description: Class designed to distinguish the different types of units that are available in variables from datasets or parameters

terms.name: Variable
terms.description: A symbol that represents a quanity in a dataset or dataset specification

terms.name: Variable presentation
terms.description: Concept used to represent an instantiation of a variable in an input/output dataset. For example, a model A may use an input file with temperature expressed in Farenheit (variablePresentation1), while a model B may produce an output with temperature in Celsius (variablePresentation2). Both variable presentations refer to the concept of temperature.

terms.name: Visualization
terms.description: Class to represent any type of visualization related to a software. For example, a dynamic HTML page, a video, etc.

relations.name: has software version
relations.description: Property designed to link a software component with its corresponding versions

relations.name: adjustable parameter
relations.description: Parameter that can be adjusted in a configuration setup

relations.name: copyright holder
relations.description: Copyright holder for a software component

relations.name: has configuration
relations.description: Property that links a model to one of its configurations. A model may have multiple configurations, each of which is unique in terms of the inputs and outputs it uses.

relations.name: has constraint
relations.description: Constraint or rule associated to a  variable or software configuration. For example: "This model accepts only monthly data", or "all inputs of this model configuration must share the same location". More structured restrictions, such as Jena rules or SWRL rules may also be captured with this property

relations.name: uses unit
relations.description: Property used to link a variable presentation or time interval to the unit they are represented in

relations.name: was derived from setup
relations.description: Property that links a setup to a previous version of that setup. This property is needed (for example) when creating snapshots of setups.

relations.name: has software image
relations.description: Function to link a function with its corresponding container

relations.name: has sample execution
relations.description: Property pointing to a sample execution of a software configuration

relations.name: has fixed resource
relations.description: Property that links a parameter or an input to a fixed value. For example, in a given configuration a parameter with the planting date for a model could be fixed to avoid the user changing it for that region.

relations.name: has sample result
relations.description: Property designed to link a software configuration to a sample resource resulting from its execution

relations.name: adjusts variable
relations.description: Property that links parameter with the variable they adjust. This property can be used when parameters quantify variables without directly representing them. For example, a "fertilizer percentage adjustment" parameter can quantify a "fertilizer price" variable

relations.name: has output
relations.description: Property that expresses what are the outputs of a model

relations.name: publisher
relations.description: Publisher organization or person responsible for a software component

relations.name: has contact person
relations.description: Contact person responsible for a software component

relations.name: logo
relations.description: Property that links to the image used as logo for a software component

relations.name: copyright holder
relations.description: Copyright holder for a software component

relations.name: funding source
relations.description: Link to the organization funding a software component

relations.name: has data transformation setup
relations.description: Property to link an input/output dataset to the specific data transformation (with URLs

relations.name: compatible visualization software
relations.description: Property that links a software component to other useful software that canbe used to visualize its outputs

relations.name: has input
relations.description: Property that links a model configuration to the input types expected by it.

relations.name: has source code
relations.description: Property designed to link a software with its software source code (which may reside in a code repository such as GitHub)

relations.name: has parameter
relations.description: Property that indicates the parameters of a model configuration

relations.name: is transformed from
relations.description: Property that links a dataset specification from a model configuration or setup to the output from a target data transformation. This occurs when a data transformation produces several outputs, but only one of them is the one needed for a model

relations.name: has standard variable
relations.description: the standard name of a variable

relations.name: has data transformation
relations.description: Property that associates an input/output with their corresponding data transformation.

relations.name: was derived from software
relations.description: Property that identifies the software used to create a visualization

relations.name: uses unit
relations.description: Property used to link a variable presentation or time interval to the unit they are represented in

relations.name: has presentation
relations.description: Property that links an instance of a dataset (or a dataset specification) to the presentation of a variable contained (or expected to be contained) on it.

relations.name: author
relations.description: The creator of a software component

relations.name: part of dataset
relations.description: Associates a presentation with a dataset where the presentation occurs

relations.name: contributor
relations.description: Contributor to a software component

relations.name: has setup
relations.description: Property used to define configurations with some fixed resources and values. The rationale of this property is to allow predefined configurations

relations.name: has contact person
relations.description: Contact person responsible for a software component

relations.name: has funding information
relations.description: Property that links a software project to its funding information

relations.name: screenshot
relations.description: Image illustrating a snapshot of the target software

relations.name: has variable
relations.description: Property that links a rule and the variable that will test it

relations.name: has presentation
relations.description: Property that links an instance of a dataset (or a dataset specification) to the presentation of a variable contained (or expected to be contained) on it.

relations.name: has sample visualization
relations.description: A typical sample visualization of the software outputs

relations.name: author
relations.description: The creator of a software component

relations.name: useful for calculating index
relations.description: Property that indicates that a software component (or any of its outputs) can be used to calculate a particular index. The rationale for this property is that indices are usually calculated by applying post-processing steps to the outputs of a software component.

relations.name: publisher
relations.description: Publisher organization or person responsible for a software component

relations.name: has part
relations.description: Property designed to reference the elements included in a sample collection.

relations.name: has standard variable
relations.description: the standard name of a variable
